description: This Java class 'ProtectViewWorker' handles HTTP requests to check if a user should be temporarily blocked (tarpitted) from accessing certain views based on hit counts and timing, implementing rate limiting and security measures within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: ProtectViewWorker
classes.description: Final class providing static methods to manage view access protection, rate limiting, and tarpitting for user logins in the OFBiz web application.

methods.name: checkProtectedView
methods.description: Static method that checks if a user should be tarpitted based on their access patterns to a specific view, updating hit counts and managing tarpitting logic.
